quest.title: The Realm of Rocks
quest.description: The Lantern Rite is here. What new changes await in Liyue Harbor this year?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Mora x44000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

chapter.num: A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon: Act II
chapter.title: The Realm of Rocks

talks.objective: Wait until 08:00 two days from now

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: So, let me get this straight — the patient disappeared right as you were delivering the medicine?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: I know it's hard to believe... but that's exactly what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: It's true! One minute she was there, and the next she was nowhere to be seen!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it's Yelan! Fancy seeing you here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... Is this a bad time?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Not at all. Just a small roadblock in the case I'm working. Ningguang asked me to investigate a patient named Lu Xiangxiang.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If you're here to find her too, then you're out of luck, I'm afraid. She went missing this morning.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: According to Dr. Baizhu, the patient vanished right under his nose, but it just seems like that should be impossible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There one second, then gone the next? Pretty sure Xiao can do something like that...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Then, you're suggesting this Lu Xiangxiang is the Vigilant Yaksha in disguise? Or some other adeptus?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... Guess not. But this is so weird! How can a living person just vanish into thin air?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Unless... Lyney decided to take his act to Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: Who is this Lyney you speak of?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, he's... Never mind. Paimon's just grasping at straws.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Let's set aside the "how" for now, and focus more on the "where."

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You mentioned this patient has a strong obsession with achieving fame and recognition?

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: Yes, she kept talking about becoming a renowned archaeologist and making a name for herself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, are we looking for a place where it's super easy to become famous?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm drawing a blank.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I think we should check out the Xiao Lantern crafting stalls.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Because it's easy to become famous by making Xiao Lanterns?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Not exactly. When the people of Liyue need a solution to a problem, their first thought would be to pray to the gods and the adepti.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If her wish is to become famous, she might write it on a Xiao Lantern in the hopes that the fabled White Horse Adeptus might make it come true.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: That certainly sounds probable.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Turns out, the White Horse Adeptus might be a lot closer to home than she thinks...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shh...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hm? What was that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: N—Nothing! Let's go check out those stalls!

talks.objective: Go to the Xiao Lantern crafting stalls

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, we're here. Still no sign of Lu Xiangxiang though.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: As long as you're patient enough, Paimon, you'll find that hunting down people is no different from hunting boars.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We need to blend into the environment, or we risk alerting the target. So, as far as everyone here is concerned, we're just ordinary tourists.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Okay! If we need to blend in, then let's make some Xiao Lanterns and write our wishes down, like everyone else!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's your New Year's wish, Yelan?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I haven't given it much thought.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Now's the perfect time to think about it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, and it can't be work-related! You gotta take a break once in a while, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're always staking out this suspect, tailing that criminal, hunting down this gang or that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which is super amazing and all, but it's gotta be exhausting!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, you should think about yourself every once in a while.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Really getting into this, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You said to blend in, right? C'mon, it's all part of the act, so you gotta think of something!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Then I suppose... it'd be to go traveling, the next time I get the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Traveling? Hahaha, that's our bread and butter! Wanna join us?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Heh, thanks for the offer, but my desk is piled high with reports on your exploits, and that's not quite the kind of "traveling" I had in mind.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I was thinking more... the lie down and do absolutely nothing kind of travel.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, something a bit more... easy and breezy, right? Hey, wait! We know just the place — the Easybreeze Holiday Resort in Natlan!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's super relaxing and full of fun activities. You've got the beautiful ocean and tons of cute little creatures called Asha! Seriously, you gotta go!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Huh, I suppose I'll have to check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Hey, guys! Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite, Gaming.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a coincidence! You here to make Xiao Lanterns too?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Haha, well it's that time of year, am I right? Thought I'd join in on the fun. You can't have Lantern Rite without making one of these!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whatcha gonna wish for?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Aw man, it's kind of embarrassing, but... whatever! The truth is, the Mighty Mythical Beasts are seriously struggling with recruitment...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: So, I'm hoping to find a few apprentices and teach 'em the art of Wushou Dancing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Awesome! Sifu Gaming here we come!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Whoa there, Paimon. One step at a time, haha. I actually need to find people first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, but Paimon bets people will jump at the chance to learn from you!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Heh, well... I wouldn't be so sure. Wushou Dancing is super physical and takes a lot of hard work to master, so it's not easy to find people.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: At this point, if the adepti can't help me, no one can! Haha...
I'll do it!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Huh?
You just said you wanted an apprentice, right? Well, I'm offering. What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Whoa, the White Horse Adeptus works faster than I thought...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, it's her — Lu Xiangxiang.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Our target!

dialogues.speaker: Lu Xiangxiang
dialogues.text: Hey! Didn't you hear me? I said I wanted to be your apprentice!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Uh... No need to shout. I heard you the first time, haha. What's your name?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Step back a bit, Gaming. This person could be dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: ...What?

dialogues.speaker: Lu Xiangxiang
dialogues.text: Hey! What... What are you trying to do? Do you know who I am? Get back!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Lu Xiangxiang, we have no intention of harming you. We just need to ask you a few questions.

dialogues.speaker: Lu Xiangxiang
dialogues.text: Get back I said!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Try to remain calm.

dialogues.speaker: Lu Xiangxiang
dialogues.text: If you come any closer, I'll... I'll...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (What the...?)
Little wisp of a being... How are you able to see me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You must be Zizhi, the Second Deadly Self.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: So what if I am? Leave at once!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope to resurrect the White Horse Adeptus, and I need your help.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: You, a mere mortal — whose own life hangs by a thread — would dare reach for the power of life and death...

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: *coughing*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that so bad?

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Unless you wish to be condemned to eternal damnation... You would do well to abandon this foolish endeavor.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: I shall speak on this no further.

dialogues.speaker: Lu Xiangxiang
dialogues.text: Don't come any closer! I... I...

dialogues.speaker: Lu Xiangxiang
dialogues.text: How did I get here? Who are you people?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Playing dumb, are we? Save it. We know you attacked those people at Wanmin Restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Lu Xiangxiang
dialogues.text: What? No, I would never! You must be mistaking me for someone else!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You don't remember?

dialogues.speaker: Lu Xiangxiang
dialogues.text: Of course not! How could I do such a thing?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: What about the photo you took near Chiwang Terrace...

dialogues.speaker: Lu Xiangxiang
dialogues.text: What photo?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's going on? It's like she lost her memory or something...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Well, this complicates things.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'll take her back for questioning and let you know what I find.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Take her away.

dialogues.speaker: Lu Xiangxiang
dialogues.text: But, I didn't do anything! I swear!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's weird... She seems so normal now, but she doesn't remember anything...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Oh, this is just great! An apprentice falls right into my lap, and now she's gone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Gaming! This is a special case. Paimon's sure you'll find one soon!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Unless you're gonna pony up and offer a real solution, Paimon, I don't wanna hear it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gaming, what's up with—

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: I'm done here! I'm gonna go find an apprentice, and I won't take no for an answer!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gaming! Wait!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it just Paimon, or was Gaming acting super weird just now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He might have been possessed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? How do you know?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Paimon about your encounter just now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, so you saw the Second Deadly Self... And you think she moved from Lu Xiangxiang to Gaming!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh oh, then we better find him before something bad happens! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Alas, why must Cloud Retainer inflict such woe upon us, Moon Carver?

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Hmph... By the order of Rex Lapis, we were supposed to make haste to the Harbor to stand watch. Yet, we arrived late — for you, in your inscrutable wisdom, chose that very moment to tend the mint.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: It is no wonder Cloud Retainer banished us to the wilderness in anger. A pity only that I — blameless as I am — was made to share in the punishment.

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Hmph, blameless indeed! You speak as if it was not you who decided to plant all that mint in the first place!

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Yet now, in its wretched state — overrun by blight and vermin — you would turn away? Utterly heartless, I say!

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Hah, were I truly that heartless, would I have rescued those seedlings from this desolate wasteland, granting them haven in your hallowed garden?

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Alas, if blame must be laid, let it fall upon Cloud Retainer for failing to recognize the virtue of our plight!

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Ah... At last, a sentiment with which I can agree.

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: If ever Cloud Retainer is away, we should steal into her abode and plant a veritable field of mint. A tempting little ruse, is it not?

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Hahaha... Positively ingenious!

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Please stop chasing us! Just let us go!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Get back here! If you keep running, I'll kill you!

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Please! We don't know anything about Wushou Dancing! Just leave us alone!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: What, you think I'm not good enough to teach you? Just agree to be my apprentices and then we can talk!

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Hm? That child... looks somewhat familiar.

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Ah, it appears to be the Wushou Dancer from Liyue Harbor. I have seen him perform on occasion.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Come, let us take a closer look.

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Has trouble befallen you, young one? Perhaps we can offer aid.

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Oh, thank the gods... Please, sir, you have to help us! This guy's trying to force us to become his Wushou Dancing apprentices, and he won't take no for an answer!

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Oh? So, it is you who require aid, not the other way around...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Get out of the way, old men! This is between us!

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Preposterous! You dare to presume we are of a... mature age?

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Listen here, brazen youth. Skilled you may be in the art of dance, yet your off-stage demeanor leaves much to be desired!

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Hold on, Mountain Shaper... Something is amiss. Look closer.

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Huh...

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Indeed, he bears the mark of something... unclean!

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: It spells trouble. You there, depart at once.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Hey! You drove off my recruits, old man!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Hmph, you'll just have to take their place, even if you're a bit on the decrepit side.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Hahahaha, many years it has been since a being has dared speak to us in such a manner.

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: Now, let us see what evildoer has sought to use you as its puppet, young one.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Y—You two! You're adepti!

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Does that strike fear in your soul?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Whoa, two adepti recruits just fall right into my lap? That white horse sure knows how to grant a wish!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gaming! Slow down! Wait for us!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Geez, take a hint, will you? I told you to stop following me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't hurt him, please!

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}? Paimon? Keep your distance from this youth. Evil has taken a hold of him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We know! It's one of the White Horse Adeptus's Deadly Selves! She's possessing Gaming!

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: The White Horse Adeptus's Deadly Selves?

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: ...Could it be that Rex Lapis called us to Liyue Harbor for this very reason?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Hey! What are you two whispering about over there? Who's gonna be First Apprentice and who's gonna be Second?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: It doesn't matter! I'm not the kind of Sifu who plays favorites!

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: Insolent spirit! Begone from this child at once!

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Hmph!

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Little mite of a mortal! Getting in my way again, I see...

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: *coughing*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't look so good.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: That is no concern of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want to fulfill people's wishes? I can help.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: No...

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Only by doing it myself... will I find peace...

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Otherwise... rage will consume me... If I lose control, all will turn to dust...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is the source of your anger?

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: The curse of time... The memories this body holds...

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Come no closer!

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: This is your final warning...

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: Insolent spirit! Begone from this child at once!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Not again...)

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: #Huh? {NICKNAME} and Paimon? A—And two adepti!?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Uh... Where are we? Weren't we just making Xiao Lanterns in the Harbor?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gaming! You're back!

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Ah... The sun is most scorching. Agitation stirs within me... I require cooling mint to beat this heat.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: And speaking of, Cloud Retainer has scorned this verdant wonder long enough! It is time for her to feel its wrath!

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: The wrath of mint! Mwahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: Mountain Shaper? Where are you going?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, now Mountain Shaper's acting weird... You don't think it spread to him, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: Spread to him? Quickly now, explain to me what has been happening.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain the recent series of events.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: What? Was I really that rude!? Geez, someone get my dad to throw a slipper at me... I just... I'm so...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! You okay, Gaming?

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: He is fine. It is simply exhaustion.

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: But, to think Mountain Shaper would succumb to something like this... It is most unexpected.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, what do we do? We can't just leave Gaming like this, but we can't ignore Mountain Shaper either, right?

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: My cultivation level rivals that of Mountain Shaper. Were I to give chase, Zizhi would but flee from his form and take refuge in mine...

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: Seek out Streetward Rambler. Cloud Retainer and the Conqueror of Demons should be with her. I shall take this child back to the Harbor and join you posthaste.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, what are all the adepti doing together?

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis charged us with keeping watch over Liyue Harbor should danger rear its head. I daresay this is the very crisis he anticipated.

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: Come, we must devise a strategy before confronting Zizhi.

talks.objective: Find the adepti in Liyue Harbor

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: The White Horse Adeptus? You mean, the mysterious white mare that aided Rex Lapis during the Archon War?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Even if it's not her, there must be some connection. She always avoided us back then, and I never knew why.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis' recent trip seems to be related to this person as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xianyun! Madame Ping! Xiao! Great, you're all here!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}. It has been quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah! Great to see you again, Xiao.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite, Paimon! You're as lively as I remember. I trust things have been well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry Madame Ping, no time to catch up — something terrible has happened!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: What is it? Has Mountain Shaper gotten himself into trouble? Moon Carver is here with you, but he is not...

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Ahem...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain the situation to the adepti.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: "The wrath of mint"? Hmph, that old fool dares to utter such nonsense behind one's back?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Yeah, that's not really our biggest concern here!

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: So, even a mere Deadly Self of the White Horse Adeptus was able to possess Mountain Shaper and affect his mind? No wonder Rex Lapis told us to gather here and await his orders...

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Mountain Shaper's cultivation is inadequate. He was caught unprepared. Were it one of us, Zizhi would hardly have found a vessel quite so... ready for the taking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, that's not what you said earlier!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Where is Mountain Shaper now?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmph, a question that hardly bears pondering. Obviously, he intends to plant mint in the vicinity of one's abode.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Ah, then he poses no great threat... We might as well let him be. Once he fulfills his wish, it's possible that Zizhi will relinquish him of her own volition.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Your ulterior motive is most obvious, Mountain Shaper. You, too, hope for Mt. Aocang to be covered in mint — one can see it clear as day.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Not to mention, Deadly Selves are born of malevolent human desires, and naturally, pose a great risk to the form and mind of all living beings. We cannot let this go unchecked.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Let me handle it. I have relevant experience and know how to deal with such situations.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One has no doubt of that, yet your involvement would likely end in armed confrontation. In one's own estimation, the time for such measures has not yet come.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Before his departure, Rex Lapis knew that Zizhi was active in Liyue Harbor, yet told us only to wait.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: It would seem, then, that Rex Lapis did not believe extreme measures were warranted here.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Yes, this is quite a peculiar case. After all, Zizhi's possession does not seem to come with ill-intent. It's more like... she's guiding those she possesses to fulfill their own wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Hm, there is another matter of import, however...

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: I sensed tremendous resentment emanating from her... What could be its source, to render her so unable to find peace?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "The curse of time... The memories this body holds..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #She was talking about the White Horse Adeptus' memories, right? From what {NICKNAME} said, it seemed like she was about to explode with rage, but... why?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: With Rex Lapis away, if we wish to understand that which occurred in the past, we shall have to ask her directly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She also mentioned "the curse of time"... What could that be about?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Perhaps... erosion.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Hm, indeed. We are of the same mind.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Hmm... I heard that ancient clans in the mountains once regarded the White Horse Adeptus as the daughter of Time... It seems there was some truth to that, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The daughter of Time... cursed by Time?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Time does not treat everyone equally. The longer you dwell in this world, the more it takes from you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then, what do we do?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One has devised a solution.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Based on what you have told us, it seems that Zizhi is in the habit of leaping to a different host when provoked.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One's plan is for us to block all escape routes while you confront Mountain Shaper, forcing Zizhi to reveal herself.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Then, if prior experience stands, she will have no choice but to possess you. However, not only are you able to sense it, you are also unaffected by the peculiar state of stasis.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: In other words, in that moment, you would have the chance to either subdue or persuade her.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: That is akin to walking straight into the lion's den. Allow me to go instead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, isn't this plan a bit too risky?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why doesn't Paimon try first? After all, even if she got possessed, it's not like she would pose a danger to anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, but you might eat so much you become a literal ball.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's wishes aren't all food-related, y'know!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One would not suggest this course of action if one had any such reservation.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: #Time and again, {NICKNAME} has proved immune to Zizhi's influence. Consider, for a moment, why that might be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Because... I bear the moonlight's guidance?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah! That's what the First Deadly Self told you, right?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: #Perhaps your time in Nod-Krai left you with the blessing of the newborn Moon Goddess, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: And this White Horse Adeptus clearly has a profound connection to the moon.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Indeed... Indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Have you other concerns, Conqueror of Demons?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I was just trying to fathom why Rex Lapis left without explaining the situation in detail. But now, I think I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: #Rex Lapis entrusted this matter to {NICKNAME}, which means in his estimation, {NICKNAME} must be the key to its resolution.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: So, I have no other concern. I trust Rex Lapis, and I trust you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Then, we are all in agreement on proceeding with this plan?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Very well. We should depart at once, lest we lose our chance.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Let us see whether that old fool truly dares deface one's abode with mint!

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: One mint, two mint, let us plant a whole slew of mint...

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Once I reach ten thousand, Cloud Retainer's abode shall be Mt. Aocang no more, but rather... Mt. Mint-cang!

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Oh, to behold the look on her face when she is confronted with such verdant splendor! Mwahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Mountain Shaper... You dare disturb the tranquility of one's abode!

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: Ahem... Do not take personal offense, Cloud Retainer. He is not in control of his faculties.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Exactly. Let it go this once. Zizhi is the one driving him to do this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? But Zizhi just helps people fulfill their own wishes and desires...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Not now, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oops! Sorry, Mountain Shaper. Paimon might've just thrown you under the bus!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmph, when he wakes up, we shall have words.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Everyone, to your positions!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got this.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Huh? A pest? I must catch it!

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Again!

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Hm? Oh, young one. It is you.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Don't tell me... Cloud Retainer sent you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, she told me to get rid of the mint.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Hah! Such brazen insolence!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And... that includes your garden on Mt. Hulao.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Argh! Such presumption! Such boundless avarice! That wretched adept's impudence knows no end!

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: If she dares lay a finger on my garden, I shall smash her Cuisine Machine to pieces!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You sure about that?

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: You think I am one to fold so easily? I... I...

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: ...Insolent mortal!

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Time and again, you interfere in that which is beyond you...

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: You make it exceedingly difficult to contain my rage...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We need your help.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: You have no conception of that which you seek! It is forbidden!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Forbidden?

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: You know nothing of my past. My warning was given — the cost entwined with this is beyond what you can bear.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here because I want to know. I want to understand.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Stubborn mortal!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could even say... it's my wish.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: You...! Ugh!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will you grant it?

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Very well... If death is what you seek, who am I not to oblige...

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Come, let us see the extent of your resolve...

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Your wish is to behold the curse of time and the memories of this form... Then, let it be granted.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: You who seek death, stand before me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: My prison.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're trapped here?

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: I was merely a trace of impure energy within Zibai's immortal body. When her soul was shattered, it should have been the end of me.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: But then, the one who governs Time descended from on high and froze the moment of her death.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: And so I remain in this world, unable to find release.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Was it... Istaroth?

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: A mortal who knows of her existence and would dare to speak her name? Who are you?

choices.text: I am someone who can help you.

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: Help... Heh, no. There is nothing we can do for each other.

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: Her power, the one who governs Time... It has surrounded me ever since — a blessing and a prison, all at once.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, you've been trying to break free?

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: No... I have been asleep in this prison for countless years, until a familiar presence woke me...

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: Then through that mortal girl's eyes, I saw it, as pure and bright as ever, unchanged across the millennia... It was the moon.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No wonder she took that picture at Chiwang Terrace...

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: That place is called Chiwang Terrace? Did later generations rebuild the altar in a new location...? It looks just like the one used to honor Zibai.

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: Could it be that traces of what happened back then still remain in this world...?

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: That memory... is embedded deep within the essence of Zibai's soul. It is one that should have been forgotten.

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: Yet, it is precisely that which haunts my every waking moment, fuels my rage, and denies me a modicum of peace...

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: Now you, a mere mortal, come to seek that which is forbidden. So, let us see whether the fire that fuels your ambition is a hero's wisdom... or a fool's courage.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do I need to do?

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: I shall relinquish control over this body's curse and let it devour everything within sight.

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: Run as fast as you can, lest this prison become your grave.

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: Look, it draws near. The river of time, come to sweep all into oblivion... a torrent of tears for the dead and departed.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This... must be the curse of Time.

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: I shall wait for you at the end, mortal. Evade being swept up in its waters, and I will show you everything.

response.speaker: Zizhi
response.text: Fail, and we shall sink into oblivion together.

choices.text: I am someone seeking your help.

talks.objective: Escape the onrushing torrent of time
Go to the end of this place

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Ha, I did not expect that you would make it to the end.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I did it.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Yes, it would seem even time cannot hold you back. In that case, perhaps this truth is one you can bear.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Come, let your wish be granted.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Now, you know the truth. These are the memories that suffocate me where I stand, and crush me under their weight.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your nation was destroyed...

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Not just my nation, but the people I loved.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Were it within my power, I would ignite a blaze fierce enough to burn a hole through the heavens themselves!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But, how did it all happen...?

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: It was a time of war, one that ravaged heaven and earth. Remnants of the battles, tainted with cursed power, fell from on high and devastated Lang-Gan.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: The heavens decreed that the tainted filth had to be cleansed... no matter the cost.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: If I just had more time... I could have helped more people to escape...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You did give them time.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: But, it wasn't enough! I just needed a bit more, and they all could have survived!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You did more than enough.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The descendants of Lang-Gan made their home all throughout Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Their legacy lives on because of you.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: I never imagined there would come a day where I found peace.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: So long this rage has been within me, yet here in this moment, it has stilled at last. Thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: If you wish to bring Zibai back to life, mortal, then you may take the part of her soul that lives in me.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Just remember — from this moment onward, the fate of Lang-Gan's fallen rests on your shoulders, and that cannot now be changed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What will become of you?

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: As I said before, I am but a remnant of Zibai's adeptal form — a manifestation of her wrath that was not meant to linger in this world...

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: By taking away this fragment of her soul, you take away my shackles as well. So, let it be done.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any final wishes, then?

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Ah, it's your turn to grant one of my wishes, is it? Very well. In regard to my fate, and that of Lang-Gan's fallen... I know there is little I can demand of you.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: However, should another raise a war banner against the heavens someday, let my name be set upon its cloth.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: I ask for this, and nothing more.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Now, take what you came for.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: I was a lone moon, shrouded and dimmed in cloud-veiled night.

dialogues.speaker: Zizhi
dialogues.text: Now darkness breaks, free and unburdened, I reclaim my light.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: You think I am one to fold so easily? I... I...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I'm back...)

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Ah, young one. What brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: My... what exquisite mint seedlings! Was it you who planted them? I had not taken you for one so versed in the horticultural arts! I must insist that you visit Mt. Hulao. There is much we could learn from one another.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: Ah, but this is Cloud Retainer's abode. She does not appreciate the verdant wonder that is mint.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: We should leave at once... If she sees us here, there is little I can do to protect you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wasn't the one who planted them.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: You weren't? Was it Moon Carver, then? My, what nerve he has.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was you.

dialogues.speaker: Mountain Shaper
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Looks like Mountain Shaper is back to normal. Has the matter with Zizhi been resolved, then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that was fast! That took, what like... a second?

dialogues.speaker: Moon Carver
dialogues.text: #A second to us, perhaps. But, for {NICKNAME}... I imagine it felt much longer than that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Zizhi is gone now.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One's plan was most successful, then.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: #And you're alright, {NICKNAME}? You don't feel strange in any way?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, I'm fine, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Well, sounds like good news all around. I'm glad this matter is resolved.

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: What is this matter you speak of? The possession of that mortal child?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmph, the matter of Zizhi may have been resolved... But there is another that is far from over — the mint you planted around my abode.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Perhaps you have a moment to spare for a little chat, Mountain Shaper?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As Cloud Retainer gives Mountain Shaper a firm talking to, Xiao pulls you aside.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You seem reluctant to talk in detail about what happened with Zizhi.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She told me about her past...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I won't ask you to reveal her secrets to me. And I doubt the other adepti will either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You don't wanna know what happened?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: #The expression on your face... I know it well, {NICKNAME}. It's one I've seen Rex Lapis wear on many occasions. Whatever you learned, it must be too heavy to share.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But you're okay, right, {NICKNAME}? That Deadly Self didn't hurt you, did she?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, nothing like that. I'm fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, as long as you're not hurt, Paimon doesn't need to know anything else!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It just... isn't a happy story.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Even so, I hope you feel like you can entrust me with it.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: If I learned anything from our time together, it's that one should not have to shoulder such a weight alone.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Not to mention that certain knowledge brings danger in its wake... I would never want you to feel forced to be the sole keeper of such secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Kinda like how one person can't finish a whole slime, y'know? Better to grab a bunch of friends and eat it all together!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Time to call in some fellow slime connoisseurs, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Exactl— Wait, no! Paimon's just saying, we've got loads of friends who'd be more than willing to lend an ear!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, then.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After careful consideration, you share what you learned about Lang-Gan.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...I never knew there was such a tragic chapter in the ancient past of this land...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, the people of that nation worshiped the White Horse Adeptus as the God of Soil and Grain.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: It would seem, then, that Rex Lapis had a similar reason for withholding the details of his recent trip.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I've often wondered if he had companions to stand by him before we met... or if he was forced to face things alone.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Regardless, Lantern Rite takes place in two days. Let's meet back up again there.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: If there's no news of Rex Lapis by then, we'll have to come up with a plan.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, see you in two days.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fingers crossed it all goes well!

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Is it possible I was just imagining things?

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: But, I saw it too! We can't both have been imagining it!
